ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) distribution across >95% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are localized to distal tips and sparse focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation field; distinct high-contrast white geometric clusters (barnacle colonies) mapped to the extreme left and right distal tips; minimal micro-scale white mottling along the trailing edge perimeter.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate vertex angle of 45-50 degrees; notch depth occupies roughly 15% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) of 2-10 pixels along the distal 70% of both trailing lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-sweeping trajectory with convex superior margins and slightly concave inferior trailing boundaries leading to sharp distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white/tan) at both distal tips; sparse, isolated white focal spots on the mid-ventral surface of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned light-grey linear pixel streaks visible on the medial portion of the left lobe's ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced barnacle colonization appearing as textured, high-relief light-colored masses at the extreme lateral fluke tips.
